info.title: Vidu Q4
info.description: Generate video from one starting frame or reference images, with optional reference audio.

post.summary: Submit a Vidu Q4 video task

reference-to-video.summary: Video guided by reference images and audio

input.prompt: Animate the character from the reference image with movement guided by the reference audio.

BearerAuth.description:
All API endpoints require Bearer Token authentication.

Create an API key: sign in to PoYo, open **Dashboard → API Key** at [poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key](https://poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key), and click to create a key.

Add it to the request header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL for task completion or failure notifications.

prompt.description: Video instructions, up to 5,000 characters. Required and non-empty for reference-to-video; optional for image-to-video.

image_urls.description: Exactly one starting-frame image for image-to-video. Cannot be combined with reference_image_urls or reference_audio_urls. Use publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URLs.

reference_image_urls.description: Required for reference-to-video. Provide 1-12 reference images. Cannot be combined with image_urls. Use publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URLs.

reference_audio_urls.description: Optional reference audio accompanying reference_image_urls. Supports up to 3 MP3 files, each 3-12 seconds long. Audio cannot be used without reference images. Use publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URLs.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio for reference-to-video. Do not send this field for image-to-video.

generate_audio.description: Generate an audio track for reference-to-video. Do not send this field for image-to-video.

input.description: Provide one image_urls starting frame, or a prompt with 1-12 reference_image_urls. Reference audio is optional and requires reference images.

code.description:
Business status code. `200` means success; any other value means the request failed. Always check this field: some validation errors return HTTP 200 with `code: 400` in the body.

- `200`: Success
- `400`: Invalid request parameters
- `401`: Missing or invalid API key
- `402`: Insufficient credits
- `403`: Permission denied
- `404`: Resource not found
- `408`: Request timeout
- `429`: Rate limit exceeded
- `500`: Internal server error
- `502`: Upstream service error
- `503`: Service unavailable

See [Error Codes](/api-manual/error-codes) for details.

status.description:
Task status. Always `not_started` right after submission. Use [Query Task Status](/api-manual/task-management/status) or `callback_url` to get later states.

- `not_started`: Queued, waiting to be processed
- `running`: Being generated
- `finished`: Completed; results are in `files` or `output`
- `failed`: Failed; details are in `error_message`
